issues.description: Attribute Bitmap24::width has conflicting types between artifacts. In the template (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) the field is declared as 'short width;' while in the solution (example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) it is declared as 'int width;'. Constructors and usages in both template and solution source files use int parameters for width/height (constructor signature Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height)), so the template member type ('short') can cause narrowing/truncation and is inconsistent with the rest of the API, which may confuse students and lead to subtle runtime/portability issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bitmap24::width member type consistent across template and solution. Prefer changing the template declaration from 'short width;' to 'int width;' in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp to match constructor parameters and the solution. Update any comments or usages that assume a 16-bit width if necessary.
